sources.publisher: AECID (Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation), full text of the call published in the National Subsidies Database (BDNS 916186)
sources.note: Full call resolution of 29 June 2026: section 1.2 point 3 states the field rule; section 4 scoring criteria; no annex or list of master's programmes

sources.publisher: Boletin Oficial del Estado (extract of the call)
sources.note: Extract: up to 30 grants for official in-person master's of at most 60 ECTS credits in Spain

subject_rule: Not tied to a list of fields: the call says the application is for an official in-person master's of at most 60 ECTS credits in Spain, 'en el ámbito de estudios del área correspondiente al perfil académico o profesional del candidato' (in the study area matching the candidate's academic or professional profile), and scores the fit between the applicant's public-sector job and the chosen master's and with Spanish cooperation priorities.
notes: No list of fields or master's programmes exists in the call or its extract, so no programmes are recorded (0). The applicant chooses any official master's of up to 60 ECTS credits that matches their profile and for which they hold admission for 2026-2027.
not_stated: A statement that any subject is allowed (the call ties the master's to the applicant's own profile and job, so any_subject is left unset)
Any list of eligible master's degrees or universities
